title: Two Movie Reviews
text:
Sam watched a new film about a dog last night. He wrote a review on his blog. He said the story was funny and the actors were good. He gave the film three stars out of five.

Maria read Sam's review on Monday. She does not like comedies, so she chose a different film. She watched a science film on Friday. She said the ending was surprising, and she wrote a review too.

questions.text: How many stars did Sam give the film?
What kind of film did Maria watch on Friday?
Why did Maria not watch Sam's film?
options: She was too busy to watch films
She did not know about the film

questions.text: How do you think Sam feels about the film?
options: He enjoyed it, but not completely
He did not watch it all
He was angry about the actors

people who perform in films or plays
the last part of a story

paragraph_translations: Sam obejrzał wczoraj wieczorem nowy film o psie. Napisał recenzję na swoim blogu. Powiedział, że historia była zabawna, a aktorzy dobrzy. Dał temu filmowi trzy gwiazdki na pięć.

Maria przeczytała recenzję Sama w poniedziałek. Nie lubi komedii, więc wybrała inny film. W piątek obejrzała film science fiction. Powiedziała, że zakończenie było zaskakujące, i też napisała recenzję.
